LSUBR cons is now implimented in the compiler, and is turned on in the
currently being developed interpreter (and seems to win fine).  Therefore,
unless there are any gross complaints or screws, the interpreter will support
LSUBR cons in the next release.

I would like to put in my two cents (once again):
I would rather see it be LIST* then LSUBR cons.

--Howard
